candidates.explanation: The BRCA1 nonsense mutation p.Q1538* in this tumor is linked to sensitivity/response to Rucaparib. The same BRCA1 p.Q1538* alteration is identified as a direct target of Rucaparib in drug-gene interaction data. Together, these clinical and target evidence support considering Rucaparib as a candidate therapy for this patient.

candidates.explanation: The BRCA1 nonsense mutation p.Q1538* is associated with sensitivity/response to Talazoparib (evidence score 0.456). The same BRCA1 mutation is identified as a target of Talazoparib in drug-gene interaction data (evidence score 0.443). The mutation’s roles in cellular response to tumor necrosis factor and chromosome segregation provide a mechanistic basis for PARP inhibition with Talazoparib.
